notes: Eight own pages read on ezlynx.com, all HTTP 200 and not thin. EZLynx publishes no prices: the pricing page says price depends on users and products, so every dollar figure is unverifiable. C07 (a single flat fee) is classed wrong against the pricing page's explicit no single flat rate; a reviewer may read the answer as one combined bill, which the same page also describes. Cause tracing for C07 read agencymate.com and quicksilversystems.com (neither carries it); the cited Reddit thread was disallowed by robots.txt and the two other cited Reddit threads were not requested. C02 (acquired March 2021) is unverifiable here because no EZLynx page dates it, although Applied's own 2021 press list confirms it (true in the Applied Systems file). Lower bounds classed true as written: C26 (20,000+ against 37,000+) and C28 (300+ against 330+); C30 (330 to 350+) is classed true because the published 330+ falls in the range. Not coded: the core product name EZLynx Management System used as a name, review ratings and sentiment scores, awards, a patented retention workflow, the 2026 commercial quoting launch date, quote volumes (8 million rating transactions), hedged lines (network membership may qualify for a discount; a 10-user setup could cost about $15,000; possible setup, conversion and usage charges; additional fees may apply), conditional choose-if lines, and statements whose subject is another vendor (HawkSoft's bridge to EZLynx rating, HawkSoft's free trial). Pass 2 (8 Oct 2026): no browser reads exist for this vendor and no claim was unverifiable because of a blocked or thin page; the eight-page own-page allowance is used, so no page was added, and nothing was re-classed (QuickBooks, Sales Center, Agency Automation, Connect Marketplace, tiers, subscription and the acquisition date are not on any EZLynx snapshot). Gap lines were fit opinions, feature descriptions (native CRM, commercial quoting workflow), comparisons, hedged costs, or about other vendors (Momentum AMP $99, QQCatalyst, HawkSoft); price cells already coded for the same answers were not repeated. Instances added from sub-headings and tables: q8 Claude run 2 per-user costs to C03; q2 Claude run 3 tiered from $150 per user to C05 and C16; q7 Claude run 3 to C27 (330+) and C29 (350+, attributed to some sources); q7 AI Overviews run 3 to C28 (over 300). Consistency check: C07 stays wrong; the pricing page's no single flat rate is an explicit statement about the same pricing structure the answer describes, but a reviewer should look first, since the page also says everything comes on a single bill. The pricing page offers a free trial, but no answer makes a free trial statement about EZLynx.
